title: Understanding the Graph
text: The graph shows the relationship between model complexity and the components of error: bias squared, variance, and irreducible error. As model complexity increases, bias squared decreases and variance increases.

title: Ridge Penalty and Lambda
text: The Ridge penalty term is controlled by lambda (λ). A larger λ penalizes the coefficients more, leading to simpler models with higher bias and lower variance.

title: Interpreting Lambda on the Graph
text: On the graph, the left side represents high bias and low variance, which corresponds to a large λ. The right side represents low bias and high variance, corresponding to a small λ.

hintAnswer: The right side of the graph represents small λ.
title: Determine the Side for Small Lambda
text: Based on the graph and the effect of λ, which side of the graph represents small λ?
choices: The left side of the graph represents small λ.
The right side of the graph represents small λ.
